chat.title: Assistant
chat.welcome: How can I help? I can look up and summarize data, or change data once you confirm.
chat.paused: The assistant is paused by the platform; new conversations cannot start for now.
chat.notConfigured: No model is configured yet. Ask an administrator to add one under Agent settings.
chat.fork: Fork a new conversation from here

thread.removeConfirm: Delete the conversation "{title}" and all its messages? This cannot be undone.

approval.title: Needs your confirmation
approval.keys: With the card itself focused: Enter approves, Esc rejects

blocked.permission: You lack the permission for this ({perm}). Ask an administrator to grant it, then try again.
blocked.mode: This conversation is read only and cannot change data; switch the approval mode and ask again.
blocked.policy: The platform does not allow the assistant to use this tool.

question.title: The assistant has a few questions
question.external: These questions come from the external server "{name}": your answers are sent to it, so do not enter anything that must not leave the system.

composer.label: Message
composer.placeholder: Type a message: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line; $ picks a skill, {'@'} mentions, / runs a command, Ctrl+R searches sent messages
composer.queuePlaceholder: This turn is still running; a message sent now follows its current step
composer.queueHint: A turn is running: what you send now is handled after its current step.
composer.noVision: This model cannot read images: remove the image attachments or pick a model that can.
composer.promptPlaceholder: Type to filter prompt templates; Enter inserts, Esc cancels
composer.planHint: Read only: lists a plan first and runs it once you confirm
composer.historyPlaceholder: Type to search your sent messages, Enter fills in, Esc cancels
composer.queueExpired: Queued message expired and was not automatically executed

slash.status: Usage and state of this turn
slash.clear: Clear and start a new conversation
slash.noSetting: You have no access to the Agent settings page

status.title: Turn status
status.none: Nothing has run in this conversation yet
status.legacyHint: Includes legacy records without usage details

action.copyFailed: Copy failed; select the text and copy it yourself
action.editing: Editing the last message: sending forks a new conversation

revert.title: Revert last turn
revert.confirm: Revert the last question and answer? Changes the assistant already made in that turn stay.

error.generic: Something went wrong, please try again

mention.recordHint: A record brought from the page

saveSkill.working: Writing a skill draft from this conversation…
saveSkill.done: Skill draft "{name}" created (disabled); check it, then enable it

shortcut.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcut.stopHint: Stop works in the empty message box while a turn runs; the others anywhere on this page. Saved in this browser only.

conflict.reserved: {key} is already used by the page

notify.title: Notifications
notify.hint: You always get an inbox message; the mobile app reads the inbox. Emails go to the address in your profile.

event.waiting: Waiting for my confirmation or answer

panel.scope: Only the loaded conversation is summarized here. Approvals stay in the conversation cards.
panel.noTools: No tool activity in this conversation
panel.noSources: No web sources in this conversation
panel.noOutputs: No outputs yet. Expand an answer to read it here.

dock.escapeHint: In the message box, Esc minimizes the window while work continues. Use Stop or a shortcut with a modifier key to stop.

subtask.readonly: Read-only subtask. Return to the main task for actions and follow-up instructions.
subtask.failed: This subtask could not be loaded. Please retry.
subtask.empty: This subtask has no output yet.

connection.reconnecting: Connection interrupted. Reconnecting; saved content will be caught up after recovery.
connection.down: Not connected. Check uncertain delivery before retrying; minimizing does not cancel background work.

delivery.uncertain: The previous delivery is unconfirmed. Recovery checks its receipt without automatically resending.
delivery.clearConfirm: The previous request may have been accepted. Discarding its local identity does not cancel server work. A later send will be a new message. Continue?
delivery.different: Check the previous delivery or explicitly discard it before sending different content.
delivery.accepted: The previous message was accepted. View it in its conversation; your later draft is preserved.
delivery.removed: The previous message or conversation was removed and will not be resent.
delivery.missing: No acceptance record was found. To retry, keep the original message and click Send again.
delivery.memoryLost: Message text was not saved locally. Check its receipt; explicitly discard this delivery before typing a replacement.
delivery.storageUnavailable: This browser cannot save receipt identifiers. Keep this page open; after refreshing, manually verify the previous delivery.

recovery.required: A previous operation may have taken effect or incurred a charge. Writes and image generation are paused. Read-only questions remain available and model calls are still metered.
recovery.confirm: First confirm that the previous operation has ended, then check its actual effect or charge in the business system or provider records. This only allows future operations; it does not rerun old work, queued messages or re-enable an automation.
